hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: Your cards — 3, 10. You raised before the cards were dealt. Your opponent called.
Flop — Ace, 5, King. You bet. Your opponent just called.
Turn — 4. You bet again. Your opponent raised you.

wrongReasons: 6 7 has little reason to lead the river here — one pair can't comfortably go for value after calling two streets.
7 A has little reason to lead the river here — two pair can't comfortably go for value after calling two streets.
3 4 has little reason to lead the river here — two pair can't comfortably go for value after calling two streets.
hand.explanation:
Answer: K A

Your opponent flopped a full house and slow-played the flop, calling to disguise their strength. Once the pot was big enough they raised the turn and shoved the river — a classic trap with a monster hand.
